thread:
Sam: Heads up — since the RBAC tweak rolled last night (limited kms:Decrypt to svc-account:rotator), we're seeing intermittent mTLS handshakes failing for services in eu-west-2. Failures correlate with certs that are provisioned via the rotator. Logs show KMS decrypt denies and then downstream TLS errors. 
Natalie: ugh, saw alerts too. can you paste the error snippet? :eyes:
Sam: log snippet: `2026-03-23T02:14:12Z rotator: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:...` then `tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: internal_error`
Ryan: so RBAC change probably removed the rotator's permission to unwrap leaf private keys. did we change the role binding for the rotator SA?
Sam: yes — PR #392 tightened KMS decrypt to only allow `svc-account:rotator` but the cert-proxy job runs as `svc-account:cert-proxy` in eu-west. That mismatch looked fine in staging but hit prod.
Natalie: audit-bot: can you link the KMS audit events for those timestamps?
audit-bot: Attached KMS CloudTrail events (3 entries) — `kms:Decrypt` denied for principal arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/cert-proxy-eu/` at 02:14:12, 02:16:01, 02:17:45 
infra-oncall: quick triage: if cert provisioning fails, services fall back to stale certs and eventually hit handshake failures when cache expires. short term: we can re-grant decrypt to cert-proxy in eu-west. long term: ensure a single role or role-mapping for all rotator/proxy tasks.
Ryan: agree. temporary fix: `iam attach-role-policy --role-name cert-proxy-eu --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::...:policy/KMSDecryptRotator` — but let's avoid manual AWS console edits during peak. propose an emergency k8s patch to run rotator as the cert-proxy SA for the job in eu-west.
Natalie: also noticing audit logs don't include the pod name for the deny — CloudTrail shows the IAM principal but our correlating metadata in the cert-issuer was missing. we should surface pod/namespace via sts:TagSession or add logging to rotator.
Sam: for verification, run this from a debug pod in eu-west: `openssl s_client -connect cert-proxy.eu-west-2.internal:443 -alpn h2 -state -debug` and `kubectl logs -n platform cert-proxy-... | grep Decrypt`
Ryan: I'm pushing a canary patch to the cert-proxy k8s job to run as `svc-account:rotator` and adding an env `KMS_AUDIT_TAG=cert-proxy` so CloudTrail shows session tags.
Natalie: add an ingress / egress firewall note — if cert-proxy retries hit other regions KMS, we must ensure the routing policy doesn't leak keys to other partitions.
Sam: quick mitigation checklist: 1) rollback RBAC change for eu-west cert-proxy (grant kms:Decrypt) 2) restart failed cert-proxy pods 3) verify `kubectl get certificates -A` shows renewed certs 4) confirm no more `tls: handshake error` in service logs 5) add session tagging and enrich audit logs
infra-oncall: I'll own step 1+2. Sam and Ryan, please coordinate a safe window. We should also run the runbook `playbooks/mTLS-rotator-fallback.md` (internal) — it's the one with fallback to cached key unwrap.
Sam: before we do anything, let's snapshot current policies: `aws iam get-role-policy --role-name cert-proxy-eu --policy-name KMSDecryptRotator` and save to S3 `s3://internal-playbooks/incident-4901234567/policies/`
Ryan: doing that now. I'll also add a short-lived canary: create a duplicate cert-proxy job with `serviceAccountName: rotator` and scale=1. If that succeeds, we can be confident it's an RBAC-only issue.
Natalie: FYI I found two related gaps: a) audit retention for CloudTrail in eu-west was 30 days and our investigation window needs 90 for compliance — raising a ticket with infra to extend. b) TLS config: we still accept TLS 1.2 with some obsolete ciphers on east-west links; we should harden to only ECDHE + AES-GCM and TLS1.3 where supported.
Sam: noted. for the TLS hardening, create a tracked follow-up — not part of immediate incident. the priority is restoring decrypt so certs can be unwrapped.
infra-oncall: update — role-policy restored for cert-proxy-eu at 02:42:10 UTC (granted kms:Decrypt on key alias/rotator-eu). restarted pods at 02:44:01.
Sam: re-issuing certs now, `kubectl logs` shows `decrypt succeeded` and `certificate signed`. running smoke tests against a few east-west services.
Ryan: smoke looks clean. no more `handshake error` in the last 10m. pushing a small infra PR to centralize KMS role mapping: `k8s/iam-mappings/central-rotator-map.yaml`.
Natalie: created jira INC-2431 to track: "Audit enrichment + RBAC mapping + TLS config hardening" and assigned to Security/Infra. Set severity to P2 because we had customer-facing errors for ~30 minutes.
Sam: postmortem notes: root cause = RBAC tighten without cross-checking all SA footprints in prod; contributing = missing session tags in KMS audit and shorter CloudTrail retention. Remediation: 1) add session tagging to all KMS clients 2) canonicalize rotator/proxy SA (one mapping per region) 3) extend CloudTrail retention to 90d 4) TLS cipherlist hardening RFC by end of Q2.
infra-oncall: leaving incident channel for now, will follow up in incident doc. ping me if anything resurfaces. :white_check_mark:
